# Foregather

> Portable invitation transfer, spoken verification and experimental live pairing in Rust/WASM. MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 TheCryptoDonkey. Self-hostable with no required hosted service.

This is a navigation index for readers and AI tools, not a guarantee of indexing.
Foregather returns application input for explicit review. Applications own room
admission, identity, membership, consent, replay policy and continuing traffic.
Live PAKE is experimental, unaudited and not RFC 9382 wire compatible.
